judge.what_is_spun: HEG's graphite electrodes business (including other carbon products) demerged into HEG Graphite Limited; parent retains thermal/hydel power plus amalgamated Bhilwara Energy.
judge.reason: Core businesses (graphite electrodes, thermal/hydel power) acquired critical mass and need flexibility, independence and focused management; segregation unlocks value, attracts different investors, matches different risk-return profiles and growth trajectories.
judge.insiders: Promoter/Promoter Group holds 100% (50,000 shares) of HEG Graphite pre-Scheme, 56.28% post-Scheme on mirror basis; in parent HEG promoter stake rises 56.28% to 60.72% via BEL amalgamation. Other incentives not stated.
judge.hidden_value: Valuer puts the demerged Graphite Business at Rs 393.4/share versus Rs 124.0 for post-demerger HEG; the spin takes Rs 4,329.30 crore assets, Rs 3,810.32 crore net worth and all Rs 1,309.63 crore revenue.
judge.selling_pressure_why: Documents state no index treatment or listing mechanics; spin is large (1:1 mirror, entire graphite revenue), not a small stub.
judge.read_next: PwC valuation report (Annexure J) and ICICI Securities fairness opinion (Annexure K) for graphite standalone basis.
judge.quote: Each of the said businesses required flexibility and independence to grow faster in the fast-changing technology and innovation driven environment.
